item.title: Nipissing Lakers women's hockey teams ends with Friday morning loss
item.description: In an early morning start, the Lakers couldn't hold a second period lead and fell 2-1 to Ontario Tech in a game the home side was forced to play on the small ice surface at the West Ferris Arena

item.title: Nipissing Women's hockey team falls in Friday morning play-in game
item.description: Forced to play at the small West Ferris Arena the Nipissing Lakers lost 2-1 to Ontario Tech in an elimination game Friday morning

item.title: More drama at Cassellholme as two prominent board members get booted
item.description: The Cassellholme soap opera continues as both Mark King and Chris Mayne were voted off the board after an in-camera meeting Thursday night

item.title: Powassan Voodoos western swing starts with solid win over Soo Eagles
item.description: Powassan moves to within two points of third place Timmins in the Northern Ontario Junior Hockey League

item.title: North Bay Battalion start very slowly in Kingston and get dumped 5-1 in second game in two nights
item.description: Battalion's four game win streak is gone and the club was coming off an emotional win in Peterborough the night before while the Frontenacs were rested

item.title: North Bay Police get their own digital forensic examiner
item.description: New position will allow searches of phones and computers without asking OPP for help.

item.title: North Bay resident faces numerous charges after OPP observe cannabis joints in vehicle
item.description: A North Bay resident is facing multiple charges after an Ontario Provincial Police officer located a driver who appeared to be slouched over inside a parked vehicle on Fraser Street. item.title: Powassan Voodoos run into hot goalie in 2-1 loss to Soo Thunderbirds
item.description: Powassan outshot the Soo 39-23 but could only score once as they miss a chance to gain on the Timmins Rock in the race for third place in the NOJHL
